## Pull request overview

This PR ensures `expand`/`populate` and `select` parameters are preserved from REST/MSW entry points through broker shims to the ObjectQL protocol/engine so lookup-style relations can be expanded instead of returning raw IDs.

**Changes:**
- Forward `expand`/`select` in the REST `GET /data/:object/:id` handler into `protocol.getData()`.
- Extend MSW `ObjectStackServer.getData()` to accept optional `{ expand, select }` options.
- Update broker shims (studio + client tests) to prefer delegating to the protocol service for proper expand/populate normalization; add/extend tests across runtime dispatcher, rest server, and protocol layers.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 8 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts | Adds dispatcher tests verifying `expand/select` allowlisting for GET-by-id and pass-through for list queries. |
| packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts | Adds tests asserting RestServer forwards `expand/select` (get-by-id) and `expand/populate` (list) into protocol calls. |
| packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | Forwards `select` and `expand` from `req.query` into `protocol.getData()` for GET-by-id. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-msw/src/msw-plugin.ts | Adds optional `options` parameter to `ObjectStackServer.getData()` to pass `expand/select`. |
| packages/objectql/src/protocol-data.test.ts | New tests for protocol-level normalization and forwarding of `expand/$expand/populate/select` into engine calls. |
| packages/client/src/client.msw.test.ts | Updates test broker shim to use protocol service when available for expand/populate behavior. |
| packages/client/src/client.hono.test.ts | Updates test broker shim to use protocol service when available for expand/populate behavior. |
| apps/studio/src/mocks/createKernel.ts | Updates studio mock broker shim to delegate to protocol for correct expand/populate support. |
</details>

In the broker shim, when `method === 'find'` and the protocol service is available, you call `protocol.findData({ object, query: params.query })`. But `data.find` callers in this file pass filters under `params.filters` (see the manual handler below), so those filters will be silently ignored whenever `protocol` is present. Consider forwarding `params.query ?? params.filters` (and similarly for `method === 'query'` if needed) to preserve the intended semantics of `data.find`.
